meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  NIST energy and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: Literature search was limited: the session's web-search quota was exhausted, so sources were located through Crossref, HAL, OSTI, arXiv and NASA ADS queries and only open copies could be read (APS, IOP, Elsevier, Canadian Science Publishing full texts were not accessible). Hyperfine constants of the ground term are second-hand from Chichinin's JPCRD review (method 'compilation'). Signs: A, B as printed (Casimir convention, E = A*C/2 + B*[...]). The M1 A value is the calculated one adopted by NIST. Values marked 'derived' were computed here from the quoted measured numbers. Two-photon entries: wavelength_vac_nm is the laser wavelength (two photons of that wavelength reach the upper level).
